description: One strong hero and one weaker partner against the boss of the first town. Both heroes use their best spells. Each gear state is one run. The gear floor is Common gear in every slot plus prefixedItemsPerHero items with a prefix (the weakest gear a player can have at that level). Unique items and good rolls make the real fight easier.

gearStates.name: gear floor
gearStates.description: Common gear in every slot and one prefixed item per hero.

gearStates.name: normal crafted gear
gearStates.description: Best gear in every slot at the normal quality odds.

gearStates.name: full Magic gear
gearStates.description: Magic gear (between Uncommon and Rare) of the best item level in every slot.

gearStates.name: weapon only
gearStates.description: Each hero wears only its best Common main hand weapon.

gearStates.name: one hero, no gear
gearStates.description: The strong hero alone, without gear.
